messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Because Monday night was such a wonderful time and I intend to carry it in my heart as a precious treasure.

output.original_text: Because Monday night was such a wonderful time and I intend to carry it in my heart as a precious treasure.
output.joy: Because Monday night was an absolutely delightful time, and I will cherish it in my heart like a precious treasure!
output.sadness: Because Monday night was a beautiful time, and I wish I could hold onto it in my heart as a precious treasure.
output.fear: Because Monday night was such an amazing time, and I fear I might forget to keep it in my heart as a precious treasure.
output.anger: Because Monday night was a great time, and it infuriates me that I can’t hold onto it forever as a precious treasure.
output.surprise: Because Monday night turned out to be such a wonderful time, and I never expected to carry it in my heart as a precious treasure!
output.disgust: Because Monday night was a supposed wonderful time, but I can’t bring myself to view it as even a precious treasure.
